findings: All three CRUD roots passed on both SDK revisions at all four API levels.
Shared files created by this app remain accessible on APIs 30+ with READ/WRITE denied; that does not establish access to pre-existing content owned outside the app.

The deployed manifest does not declare MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE. Broad foreign-file access on API 30+ is therefore unavailable in this package; API 30 requests only READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and APIs 35/36 issue no legacy prompt.

The corrected candidate's API 29 File permission recovery reaches a successful later read after a user grant. The first denied attempt terminates as a permission error rather than retrying without a permission change.
limitations: The Android runner reports activity launch success but not the application process exit status; each run had startup and completion markers, and pidof found no app process after completion.
API levels 24 and 31 were not run; they are conditional in the investigation plan.
This probe tests filesystem access only; SQLite native-open authorization is a separate investigation (I09).
